Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “smallest unit that still maintains the characteristics of copper” as the nucleus, conflating element identity (atomic number) with the full set of properties of copper. In chemistry, the smallest unit that retains an element’s characteristic properties is the atom (including its electron cloud); a bare nucleus does not exhibit copper’s chemical/electrical properties.
